Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good overview of OpTiHealth's security posture and the immediate production timelines you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we can lock in a technical deep dive focused on Private/VPC hosting and network/topology constraints.

Recap (short):
- Goal: Private deployment in your AWS VPC (shared-services account) with customer-managed networking, KMS for keys, and audit logs forwarded to your Splunk instance.
- Drivers: GDPR/PHI compliance, predictable latency for inference, and strict data residency for EU patients (you mentioned EU/US split).
- Constraints: Prefer pinned model version, limited public ingress, and a mandatory pre-launch security scan.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute architecture review (technical deep dive + ops handoff) to align network details, routing/fallback, and sequencing for PoC → prod.

Slot options (your timezone):
- Option A: Thu, Aug 16 — 10:00–11:15 PT
- Option B: Fri, Aug 17 — 13:00–14:15 PT

If neither works, share a couple of preferred windows and we’ll accommodate.

Pre-work requests (short list):
- A current VPC CIDR and whether you use shared VPCs or account-per-environment.
- Any current egress rules that would block outbound calls to our telemetry endpoints (we can provide IP/endpoint list beforehand).
- A sanitized network diagram (attachment stub OK).

We’ll bring Monica (solutions/infra) and Ben (customer ops) — Monica will lead the technical run-through. I’ll send a calendar invite once we settle the slot and include a short agenda.

Best,
David
